methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This article describes the application of the ISO 
50001 standard in energy management of companies.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a qualitative eight-stage 'mechanism' for implementing and operating an ISO 50001 energy management system in enterprises; it does not present, propose, evaluate, or critique any EnPI/EnB measurement model. No measured/normalised quantity, independent variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach is identified or characterised. This is a management-implementation framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content (v2.3 ineligible).

paper_type.evidence_quote:
the author 
has developed a mechanism that consists of the main stages of 
implementation and further operation of the energy management 
system

stage1.notes: Conceptual/managerial ISO 50001 EnMS implementation framework (8 organisational stages); no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised, so ineligible per v2.3 threshold. Context is Russian enterprises generally, not a continuous-process sector.
